subject: Post-call buying readout — procurement path, signatory lattice & marketplace preference
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ana Torres <ana@harbortech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-15T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call buying readout — procurement path, signatory lattice & marketplace preference

Hi Ana / HarborTech team,

Thanks for the time today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary from call:
- Target use: 3 prod inference endpoints for personalization (Q3) + 90-day evaluation for recommendation prototype.
- Expected monthly token volume: ~25–40M tokens after rollout.
- Technical blockers: SOC 2 evidence, MSA language around data residency, and invoice requirements.

Procurement posture you described:
- Preferred production payment method: Purchase Order (PO) / standard invoice (Net 30).
- Pilot payment: OK to put on corporate card for amounts < $5k.
- Marketplace: HarborTech prefers to purchase via AWS Marketplace for centralized procurement, but open to direct contract if Marketplace listing timing doesn't align.

Signatory/approval path (as discussed — please confirm):
- Economic/budget owner: Carlos Moreno, VP of Data
- Finance sponsor: Sasha Li, Director of Finance (approver for invoicing/PO setup)
- Legal signatory: Mark Davenport, Senior Counsel

Open items & asks for HarborTech:
1) Confirm budget owner and finance sponsor details above (contact emails if possible).
2) Confirm whether AWS Marketplace is required (vs. preferred). If required, please indicate procurement timeline for Marketplace procurement.
3) Any PO template / required fields we must populate for HarborTech invoicing.

What Redwood will do next:
- Attach: redwood-commercial-term-sheet-v1.pdf (term highlights) and procurement-checklist.xlsx (map of docs we can provide).
- Ben will scope a 60-day pilot option that allows a card payment for the pilot cap and a smooth transition to PO for production.
- Monica will coordinate legal/finance redlines and prepare a short SOW tailored to the pilot.

Proposed next steps / dates:
- Ana: confirm approvers and whether Marketplace is a hard requirement by EOD 2028-07-17.
- Redwood: return a pilot MOP (card + fallback to PO) and SOW by 2028-07-19.
- If all aligns, schedule procurement kickoff with HarborTech procurement + Redwood finance for week of 2028-07-24.

Thanks again — copying Ben and Monica so they can pick up the respective threads.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood-commercial-term-sheet-v1.pdf) (attachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx)

From: Ana Torres <ana@harbortech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: HarborTech Procurement <procurement@harbortech.com>
Date: 2028-07-16T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call buying readout — procurement path, signatory lattice & marketplace preference

Thanks Soojin — useful summary. A few clarifications from procurement: 

1) Confirmed approvers: Carlos Moreno (c.moreno@harbortech.com) is the budget owner and will sign off on the business case. Sasha Li (sasha.li@harbortech.com) will be the finance sponsor and will issue the PO once terms are agreed. Legal signatory is Mark Davenport (mark.davenport@harbortech.com).

2) Marketplace: HarborTech prefers AWS Marketplace but it's not a hard blocker — timing is the issue. If Redwood can be live on Marketplace within 4–6 weeks, procurement will prioritize that path; otherwise procurement will proceed with direct PO and attach the Marketplace tracking internally.

3) PO fields: our standard PO requires the following fields: Redwood legal entity name, Redwood tax ID, payment remittance address, and a line for "Software Subscription — inference runtime" with unit pricing. I'll share a blank PO template (attachment) if helpful.

Pilot note: Procurement is OK with the pilot on card <$5k but will ask for an internal memo documenting the scope and transition plan to PO post-pilot.

I'll upload the PO template to our procurement portal and share the link. Happy to setup a 30-min sync with my procurement lead next week.

—Ana
(attachment: HarborTech_PO_template.docx)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-16T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call buying readout — procurement path, signatory lattice & marketplace preference

Thanks for the recap and Ana for the clarifications. Internal next steps from Redwood side: 

- I will draft a mutually agreed pilot MOP (60-day pilot) that uses corporate card for initial spend and documents the handoff criteria to PO for production. Target: send MOP by 2028-07-19.
- Pre-sales (cc'd) will prepare a short technical appendix to the SOW that describes KV cache sizing and expected token profile — helps procurement and infra teams estimate costs.
- Finance question: confirm Net 30 once PO flow is active; if procurement pushes Net 45 we should flag on pricing. Monica, can you run a quick check with billing on Net45 sensitivity?

I'll also prepare a simplified term sheet for Marketplace vs direct PO so procurement can quickly compare legal footprint.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
(attachment: pilot-MOP-outline.docx)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Intake <legal@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-16T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call buying readout — procurement path, signatory lattice & marketplace preference

Ben — noted. Quick legal/ops actions I'm taking: 

- I will open a Legal intake ticket for Mark Davenport's team and attach the redwood-commercial-term-sheet-v1.pdf.
- I'll prepare a two-page redline summary for the MSA and an addendum that covers data residency and audit access for SOC 2. Expect a draft by 2028-07-19.
- I'll queue the commercial term sheet for our finance to pre-approve invoicing fields so we can populate the HarborTech PO template (Ana if you can share the template link that will speed this).

Also, propose a 30-min procurement kickoff on 2028-07-25 at 10:00 AM PT — happy to shift if HarborTech procurement prefers another slot.

Monica Patel
Head, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
(attachment: procurement-redline-guidance.pdf)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ana Torres <ana@harbortech.com>, HarborTech Procurement <procurement@harbortech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-17T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call buying readout — procurement path, signatory lattice & marketplace preference

Appreciate the fast response, Ana — that all looks good. To keep momentum: 

Action items we have right now:
- Ana: please share the PO template link and confirm whether Marketplace is "required" or "preferred" by 2028-07-17 EOD.
- Ben: send 60-day pilot MOP + pricing and the technical appendix by 2028-07-19.
- Monica: legal/finance draft redlines and SOW by 2028-07-19; prepare DocuSign-ready term sheet if procurement wants a signature path.
- Redwood & HarborTech: procurement kickoff week of 2028-07-24 (proposed 2028-07-25 10:00 AM PT).

We'll treat the pilot on card as the immediate path to unblock dev work; Redwood will ensure a clean transition checklist to PO for the production rollout. If useful, I can prepare a 1-page transition memo for HarborTech finance to attach to the pilot charge.

Thanks all — speak soon.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
